tagline: Log deployment activity to HubSpot deals and notify sales when customer-facing features ship
metaTitle: GitHub + HubSpot Integration: Releases Logged in HubSpot
metaDescription: Tell sales reps when requested features ship and log releases on HubSpot timelines. GAIA links code and CRM. See the setup steps.
intro:
Sales and engineering teams operate in separate worlds—one focused on deals and customer relationships in HubSpot, the other tracking code and releases in GitHub. When a customer's requested feature finally ships, the sales rep who promised it often finds out days later, missing the opportunity to re-engage the prospect at exactly the right moment.

GAIA creates a live connection between the two so engineering releases automatically surface in your CRM. When a release is published, GAIA logs it as an activity on relevant HubSpot deals and accounts, notifies the owning AE, and can even trigger a follow-up task to reach out to customers who requested that feature.

For product-led growth companies, this integration also lets you tie engagement signals from GitHub, like when an enterprise customer first uses a new API endpoint, back to the contact record, giving your sales team richer context for their conversations.

useCases.title: Notify sales reps when requested features ship
useCases.description: When a release includes a feature linked to a deal, GAIA notifies the deal owner with a summary of what shipped so they can immediately follow up with the customer at the ideal moment.

useCases.title: Log releases as CRM timeline activities
useCases.description: Every release is automatically logged as a timeline activity on relevant company or deal records, giving sales and success teams a complete picture of what has been delivered to each customer.

useCases.title: Create HubSpot tasks for customer-impacting bugs
useCases.description: When an issue is labeled as a customer-impacting bug, GAIA creates a task for the customer success manager assigned to the affected account, ensuring proactive outreach before the customer escalates.

useCases.title: Advance deal stages based on technical milestones
useCases.description: For enterprise deals with a technical evaluation phase, GAIA advances the deal stage automatically when key milestones are reached, such as a proof-of-concept integration being merged.

useCases.title: Track GitHub engagement signals in HubSpot contacts
useCases.description: When a customer's organization forks your public repository or opens their first issue, GAIA logs this engagement signal in their contact record so sales can reach out with perfectly timed outreach.

howItWorks.step: Connect GitHub and HubSpot to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your GitHub organization and CRM portal in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA requests read access to releases and issues, and write access to activities and tasks.

howItWorks.step: Map release events to CRM records
howItWorks.description: Define how releases map to deals, by customer label, milestone name, or repository. Configure which events create tasks, log activities, or send notifications to deal owners.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps sales informed as code ships
howItWorks.description: Every time a relevant event occurs, GAIA updates the appropriate CRM records in real time. Your sales team always knows what was recently shipped and which customers are affected.

faqs.question: How does GAIA match a release to the right deal?
faqs.answer: GAIA matches via customer or company labels on issues, release notes mentioning account names, or a mapping table you configure in GAIA's settings that associates repositories with specific companies in the CRM.

faqs.question: Can GAIA pull HubSpot deal data into GitHub for engineer context?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can add a comment to an issue with the relevant deal stage and contact information, giving engineers context about which customers are waiting on a fix or feature.

faqs.question: Does this work on the free tier?
faqs.answer: The integration works with Starter and above. Some features like custom deal properties and advanced timeline activities require Professional or Enterprise.

faqs.question: Can GAIA trigger sequences when a feature ships?
faqs.answer: Yes. When a release is tagged, GAIA can enroll specified contacts in a sequence automatically, enabling fully automated re-engagement campaigns timed to feature releases.
